target: LMR attribution flag: expose whether the capacity ceiling came from the Housing-SEPP/LMR uplift (vs the base zone tier), and show 'Low & Mid-Rise Housing applies here' on the card.
findings_summary: _realistic_forms (intelligence_brief.py:1060) returns a 2-tuple (floor, ceiling) asserted EXACTLY in tests/test_eligibility_gates.py:47-48 and used by tests/test_permitted_dev_type.py — so the return contract must not change for existing callers. Plan: add opt-in kwarg return_source=False; when True return (floor, ceiling, ceiling_from_lmr) where ceiling_from_lmr = bool(uplift_form) and ceiling == uplift_form and ceiling != base (the uplift strictly RAISED the ceiling above the base zone-tier form). Both brief call sites (2757, 3292) already compute _uplift_form via _lmr_uplift_form (one live ArcGIS 776/eligibility query) and call _realistic_forms — switch them to return_source=True and set constraint_result.ceiling_from_lmr after compute_constraint_arithmetic returns (pydantic attribute set; model_dump includes it). Add ceiling_from_lmr: bool = False to ConstraintArithmeticResult (constraint_models.py). Frontend: add ceiling_from_lmr to the TS interface and render a one-line note in the yield cell when true. No DB change, no migration, no new query (reuses the uplift already computed). Fail-safe unchanged: uplift failure -> None -> flag False -> base ceiling, no note. Tests: extend test_eligibility_gates with a return_source case (uplift wins -> True; no uplift -> False; uplift equals base -> False). GO.
